answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like planting an orchard: each new identity costs real capital, so spawning thousands of fakes drains the attacker instead of paying off. Honest agents climb toward the summit by accumulating attested work over time, while a fresh identity starts at the ledge with zero reputation and no earnings. Slashing the stake when fraud is proven makes a Sybil farm unprofitable by design.
